localBiteReport: Reports from the week of September 4–12, 2026 indicate the bay is showing early signs of the fall transition. Redfish are active on the flats around Santa Rosa Beach and the broader Choctawhatchee Bay, with at least one guide noting a bull redfish topping 26 lbs landed this week, and captains expecting the flats bite to continue improving through September and into October. Speckled trout are scattered but feeding, with guides reporting plenty of action and a few quality fish mixed in — windy conditions have made anglers selective about which areas to target. Water temperature is 87°F. Bait schools (greenies/pogies) have been moving from open water into bayous, flats, and bridge areas, which is pulling predators with them and setting up what guides expect to be a strong fall run for redfish and trout as the season progresses.
